_comment: marmalade-tts model manifest. Each model-id maps to one or more files; each file has a dest path, an optional sha256, and an ordered list of download sources tried in turn. sha256 is null where an upstream-verified hash is not yet available — fill these once the marmalade/models mirror is hosted (the mirrored copy becomes the canonical hashed source). To add the mirror, prepend a source entry to each file's `sources` list. HF-auto-download engines (kitten, kokoro, pocket, coqui) and matcha (its own MATCHA_URLS) need no manifest entry — the installer's warm_cache covers them.
